paragraphs: Hello! I'm Ahmed Nassef, a Law Graduate from Benha University with a passion for legal affairs and professional administration.

Currently, I serve as a Receptionist at Al Nas Hospital, where I manage patient coordination, appointments, and inquiries with a high level of professionalism. My background includes rigorous training in law firms, where I honed my skills in drafting contracts and legal memos.

I am a quick learner who thrives under pressure and excels in teamwork. My goal is to leverage my legal education and administrative experience to contribute effectively to a dynamic professional environment.
Beyond my professional life, I am an avid reader and committed to continuous self-development.

tasks: Receiving patients and organizing appointments and follow-ups.
Handling patient inquiries and complaints professionally.
Working on medical secretary tasks and organizing medical records and reports.
Coordinating between patients and doctors to ensure smooth workflow.
Writing legal memos and drafting contracts.
Preparing representation papers and legal documentation.
Assisted in legal research and case preparation.
Observed and participated in client consultations.
